description: THE RECOMMENDATION LEDGER - one row per recommendation a dated project report made, with what became of it: open, taken (the record section or PR) or declined (whose decision). Kept by src/analyse/report_recs.py: --sync pulls the newest report's rows in, /onboard lists the open ones, /handoff marks the taken ones, and the next report's audit reads this file instead of re-deriving it (DECISIONS.md 9.171). The first ten reports' rows live in the reports' own audits; the ledger starts at report #11 (20260914T152907, by the index's ordinals; its own audit called it the tenth).

rows.what: Make the viewer's reading safe in the harness process: report_mode_ridership.report() returns its rows (no module-global LAST), the viewer computes at most one reading at a time and never redirects sys.stdout - or runs the reporter as a subprocess with --json.
rows.evidence: 9.170: the viewer runs the reporter as a subprocess

rows.what: Land arm 0's findings in results/processed: re-run results_store.process('20260912T202242_300it_25pct', extract=True) under the bounded reader and log it; then make the close-out refuse to mark a run processed while _metrics.json / _fit.json are absent from processed/.
rows.evidence: 9.170: arm 0's _fit.json and _metrics.json extracted to processed/; session_gate --handoff checks every completed run

rows.what: Read arm 0 at its horizon and spend the routers pair first (C.raptor.mode_cost_representation = mode_constant against absent), 250 iterations at 25 %, coverage read on both sides, then scoring -> choice set -> service quality -> submodes.

Rebuild the demand so that ride is seeded at the HTS share (B.mode.bound_passenger_placement) and the short end of destination placement has an observed shape - one rebuild, one family, then re-baseline.
Require the nine test-workflow jobs as status checks in the main ruleset (ruleset 21121872) - the prepared JSON is in the session's scratch directory; the agent's API call was refused by the harness.

Retype the six hidden copies of registry values the scanners cannot see: B.population.home_jitter_radius_factor (* 0.6 at build_activity_chains.py:2416, :2789, :2872) and the four corridor VEHICLE/DWELL_DEFAULTS values (build_corridor_layers.py:117-135, :151); make check_hardcoding visit the value of ALL-CAPS assignments and dict(...) keywords.
rows.evidence: 9.170: six typed twins read from the registry

rows.what: Consume B.population.household_size_top_band_mean (size the 6+ band from its mean) at the next demand rebuild, or retire it now with a record entry.
Add refuse_concurrent_arm() to preflight() so --detach refuses a second arm before scheduling, not only in the detached log; name the scheduled task by the run stamp so --stop finds it.
rows.evidence: 9.170: refuse_concurrent_arm() at preflight; the detached run and its task share one stamp

rows.what: Price the pair arms on arm 0's innovating/tail split (199 x 351 s + 49 x 262 s + dumps) instead of one plain median, and write plans every 50 on the pair overlays.
rows.evidence: f35_scoring_msa_25pct writes plans every 50 (§9.177); the innovating/tail split pricing stays open in the pricer

rows.what: Make the gate watcher's give-up visible: when a milestone's reporter fails twice, write a verdict file saying 'unread' and print it, and let session_gate report a run whose readings ledger has a gap.
rows.evidence: 9.170: the gate watcher writes an unread verdict when the reporter fails

rows.what: Resolve a run's residents through the run's own population (output_persons.csv.gz), not the city's current B1 table.
rows.evidence: the launcher writes _residents.csv.gz at subsample and the readers prefer it; the two F35 results backfilled (#213, §9.177)

rows.what: Send the TfNSW bespoke-table request (mode x age, trip-length distribution by mode, occupancy by purpose, the unfolded Other).
Measure the replication band: three short arms at different seeds, then set CAL.objective.replication_band_pp.
Put a licence line on the published reports and the Pages site footer, and retire the reports' per-run detail that repeats the library.
Move the two document rule files to docs/tests/ (or config/) and pin the brief's and the position pages' live counts in doc_currency.
rows.evidence: 9.171: doc_shape.json is the framework's at tests/; the brief's counts are pinned (#203 #207)

rows.what: Retire closed-family gate readings from the position pages' 'What is measured' (F17-F31 rows) into their History lines, and cap a page by bytes as well as lines.
rows.evidence: 9.171: positions capped at 14,000 bytes and 600 chars a line; closed-family readings retired to History (#205)

rows.what: Record the build's wall time everywhere: wrap build_matsim_run_inputs.py, build_manifest.py, the extract adapters and the pt2matsim mapping in build_timing, and have collect_performance.py read _build_timing.json.
Hoist the three per-iteration thread pools (RemodeRestore.route x2, routeDetoursInParallel) to one pool per run, keeping one TripRouter per worker so the RNG sequence is unchanged.
Give the taxi fleet its sample fraction from RUN.sample.fraction, not qsim.flowCapFactor.
The eleventh report runs after the next reading - a pair arm's gate or horizon - and not before.
rows.evidence: report #12 (20260916T062246) followed the routers pair's reading, one reading later, with nothing between (§9.177)

rows.what: Read the scoring pair against arm 0 inside F35 - the cutoff snap, the drift, the score trajectory and coverage on both arms - then run the choice-set pair (`RUN.replanning.plan_selector_for_removal` = `SelectRandom`) and the service-quality pair (#175) in that order.

The roots rebuild, re-scoped by this pass: seed ride at the HTS share (#86), consume the household-size top-band mean (#196), give bike a literature distance cost with a sweep (#107) - and NOT a new short-trip shape: the seed already carries 17.70 % of core legs at <= 1 km network-equivalent against the Sydney 18.8 % band (measured this pass on B2_activity_trips_WEEKDAY.csv). Re-aim #30 at allocation and at the reader's distance basis.

Close out an orphan at the JVM's iteration, not the dead harness's: close_out() takes reached_iteration from iteration_times(), which prefers the digest (run_matsim.py:1840, :507-516), so `run.py --stop` on an orphan records the harness's last iteration and a 34-iteration median; and reconcile_stale() (:1235) must read the clean shutdown before the throwable, or a finished orphan is marked failed before --close-out can run.

Take the measurements the overtaken awaiting-run issues named and close or re-aim them: #66 (gc.log on a full arm - read, §9.169), #145 (the roster: 18,778 waited on the pair, unread), #162 (ptDirectWalk: 2,084,847 of 3,100,000 requests no-route, 67 %, unread), #107 (the car-availability split, unread), #94 (the near-wharf split, unread), #187 (a counter no code logs). Then make issue_gate.py flag an awaiting-run issue whose named run has completed as 'measurement due'.

Re-key the report ordinal everywhere it is typed: the index and §9.171 make 20260914T152907 the ELEVENTH and this pass the TWELFTH, while STATUS.md, the brief, lane.json and recommendations.json call it the tenth; pin the ordinal in doc_currency.json to the index row and let report_recs.py carry it.

Say where the mode gate is: every 25 % arm since arm 0 runs with `RUN.gate.interval_iterations` = 0 by overlay (six modes past the bar would stop it at 100), while GOAL.md's loop and monitoring-and-gates.md say the watcher stops at 20 %. State the scoped departure on the position page and in the loop, or restore the gate as a trend read.
Send the TfNSW bespoke-table request (mode × age, trip length by mode, occupancy by purpose, the unfolded Other) - drafted, searched everywhere public, found nowhere (§9.172); D2 is the user's.
Measure the replication band: three short arms (~100 iterations) at different seeds on F35, then set `CAL.objective.replication_band_pp` (ships 0.0).

Measure the mobsim's parallel efficiency with one 25 % JFR thread-state probe (~1.5 h): the mobsim is 64-66 % of an innovating iteration and 86 % of a tail one, thread scaling is flat (270 -> 264 s from 10 to 24 threads, §9.147), and it is the only lever that could halve an arm.

Three harness readers read the wrong thing: verify_launch.py:48 tails 400 KB and cannot see an ITERATION banner at 25 % (always 'timeout'); watch_run.py:174 attributes any JVM over 2 GB to the watched run; build_status_board.py:174-183 reads a stopped arm's newest trips table unclamped by reached_iteration.
Every archived dossier's 'current position' link is dead since the 9.171 move (31 links in 23 banners) and check_doc_links.py does not walk archived/; extend it.

Stamp a position page only when its content moved: PR #226 rewrote all 13 pages, eight by exactly +3/-3, and the two that SHOULD have taken the pair's numbers (taxi +142.6 %, bike 8.13 km) did not. Let positions.py --stamp refuse a page whose body is unchanged, and let the handoff's compare_runs step name the pages that own each headline number.

Contract gaps the checks cannot see: registry/__init__.py:472 tests categorical membership only for overlay STRINGS (a dict passes against ['uninformed','informed']); report_recs.py --check cannot see a met row (row 14's licence footers exist since 9c33018) and every row's category is null; the local gate byte-compiles src and tests but not run.py.

Fold the three Java items into ONE controler change so one family opens for all: the taxi fleet takes its fraction from RUN.sample.fraction (#215), the three per-iteration thread pools become one per run (#216), a ride whose wait times out no longer completes in zero seconds (#217).

Add a travel-time validation column: car trip time 26.9 min against the HTS 17.2 (1.57×) and the count stations at +14.3 % say the network is slower than life; a GEH statistic over the counts and a route-time constraint against the map-app congestion measurement (§9.175) would say where.

Simplify the two 500-800-line build entry points without dropping a function: build_matsim_plans.write_day (846 lines, complexity 167) and build_activity_chains.main (510) into their named stages; one haversine and one kinematic_time for the city builders (five and three copies).

One events pass for the close-out readers: summarise_run, report_mode_ridership, replay_events and frontage_volumes parse the events file with three parsers; iteration_reading already caches six tables - route the four through it.

Time what is untimed and read what is timed: collect_performance.py types 'none recorded' for build timing while _build_timing.json holds 12 builders / 1,696 s, and its nested-phase ratio exceeds 1 in the tail; wrap build_matsim_run_inputs.py, the pt2matsim mapping and build_manifest.py in build_timing.record().

Unit-test what nothing tests: 0 of 18 extract adapters, every build module but two, the harness watchers (verify_launch, watch_run, prune_run) and the Java (no JUnit; nine probe mains with 42 System.out sites).

Fix the report's own tooling where it slowed this pass: the metrics collector's one GraphQL call for 500 PRs timed out twice at GitHub's gateway (split per PR with retries this pass); the Phase 2 code lane read 12 of 39 build files and 8 of 60 Java files - give it the ranked subset as a file list so the blind spot is chosen, not accidental.
